Connect with a Peer Mentor: Support During Your Study Journey

If you are participating in the 1404-0115 Type 2 Diabetes clinical study, you may choose to connect with a peer mentor through the PatientPartner Mentor Program. This optional peer support program connects you with a volunteer mentor who has personal experience living with Type 2 Diabetes and participating in a clinical research study.

Peer mentors offer understanding, encouragement, and perspective based on their own experiences. Participation in this program is completely voluntary and is not required to take part in the 1404-0115 study. Choosing to participate – or not participate – will not affect your study participation, medical care, or relationship with the study team.

About the Peer Support Program

What is the Peer Support Program?

The PatientPartner Mentor Program provides one-to-one peer support for study participants who are interested in connecting with someone who has "been there". Mentors are volunteers who share their personal experiences living with Type 2 Diabetes and prior participation in a clinical trial.

Mentors:

  • Share personal experiences and perspectives
  • Offer emotional support and encouragement
  • Help study participants feel less alone during their study journey

Mentors are not healthcare professionals, study staff, or representatives of the study sponsor, and they do not provide medical advice. All medical questions should be directed to your healthcare provider or study team.

How the Program Works

If you choose to participate:

  1. You will review the program overview and provide informed consent to participate in the peer support program.
  2. You will complete a short questionnaire to help match you with a mentor.
  3. You may communicate with your mentor through secure messaging

Participation is flexible. You may communicate as often – or as little – as you choose, and you may pause or withdraw from the program at any time without penalty.

Privacy and Confidentiality

All mentor-mentee communication takes place through our secure platform. Your personal information is protected and not shared publicly.

Why Some Participants Choose to Join

Some study participants find that connecting with a peer mentor helps them:

  • Feel supported by someone who understands living with Type 2 Diabetes
  • Gain perspective from another patient's study experience
  • Feel more confident navigating the emotional aspects of study participation

Participation in this program is optional and may or may not be helpful for everyone.

Program Sponsorship

The PatientPartner Mentor Program for the 1404-0115 study is supported by Boehringer Ingelheim and delivered by PatientPartner, an independent platform that facilitates peer-to-peer support. The sponsor does not have access to mentor-mentee conversations.
